svg.text: Boarding and alighting each get a path
Queue each side of the doors, keep the middle for alighting. Watch crowds cross the platform.
Doors open at the stop: alight through the middle, board from the sides.
↑ To the concourse — escalators + stairs + lifts (exit here)
The train stops at the platform edge; passengers use the doors.
Doors line up with the screen doors — board and alight here.
C. Passengers find their own way
Join doors, level changes and exits; passengers pick their own routes.
Long queues make riders reroute. Leave more alternatives.
Wheelchair users need lifts or ramps — on every level change.
